raw_response: {"diagnosis": "85 raw_transactions rows are in EUR, but silver_transactions sums the raw amount as if it were USD. raw_fx_rates has a EUR rate of 1.25 (as_of 2026-01-01, before every transaction), so silver can convert amounts to USD with it.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(r.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, r.customer_id, CAST(r.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(ROUND(r.amount * f.rate_to_usd, 2) AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(r.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(r.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions r LEFT JOIN raw_fx_rates f ON f.currency = r.currency WHERE r.status = 'POSTED'"}}
